meta.name: portfolio-flow
meta.description: Generates a complete designer portfolio website with admin login, portfolio CRUD management, AI-powered project description generation, theme customization (5 presets or custom hex), and visit analytics. Deploys to EdgeOne Pages with Edge Functions, KV Storage, JWT auth, and middleware. Use when a user wants to build a personal portfolio site, designer's online showcase, individual brand website, or multi-discipline design portfolio covering landscape, graphic, interior, industrial, or UX/UI design. Triggers include: "做一个设计师作品集" "做一个个人作品集网站" "建一个景观/平面/室内/工业/UX设计师作品集" "PortfolioFlow 建站" "生成作品集" "make a designer portfolio" "build a personal portfolio" "create a designer showcase site" "用 PortfolioFlow 做一个作品集".

howto.what: Claude 会生成一个完整的设计师作品集网站，包括前台展示、管理后台、AI 生成作品介绍、主题色自定义和访问统计，并部署到 EdgeOne Pages。
howto.when: 当你提出要做一个设计师作品集或个人品牌网站，例如说“做一个设计师作品集”、“生成作品集”等触发词时。

say.text: 帮我做一个景观设计师作品集，姓名李博。
say.note: Claude 会收集信息并生成网站。

say.text: 用 PortfolioFlow 建一个 UX 设计师作品集。
say.note: 触发技能并指定设计领域。

howto.what_en: Claude generates a complete designer portfolio website with frontend showcase, admin panel, AI-powered project description generation, theme customization, and visit analytics, then deploys to EdgeOne Pages.
howto.when_en: When you ask to build a designer portfolio or personal brand site, e.g., saying "make a designer portfolio" or "generate a portfolio".

say_en.text: Create a landscape designer portfolio for Li Bo.
say_en.note: Claude will collect info and generate the site.

say_en.text: Use PortfolioFlow to build a UX designer portfolio.
